authority: Department for Levelling Up, Housing and Communities planning.data.gov.uk
verified_contracts: coordinate searches return entities whose geometry intersects the supplied point when latitude and longitude are both supplied
UPRN may be supplied through q and is described as more precise than coordinate search for registered properties
entity responses include dataset, dates, WKT geometry and point fields where available
absence of results does not prove absence of constraints because coverage varies by area
geometry_entity, geometry_reference and geometry_curie support spatial filtering with an explicit geometry_relation
geometry_relation accepts within, equals, disjoint, intersects, touches, contains, covers, coveredby, overlaps or crosses
limit and offset control result pagination
field and exclude_field control response fields, with field taking precedence
quality is an optional entity-search filter
bulk dataset downloads are available as CSV, JSON and where applicable GeoJSON and Parquet
the API remains beta and may change

candidate_gate.reason: official API contract verified but exact candidate response bytes were not safely read back
